DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この原稿の吹き出しについて、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the speech bubbles in this manuscript?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 吹き出しに文字がありません。私が日本語を読めないから見落としているのではなく、まだ文字が入っていないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 吹出し空欄は読解の見落しではなく文字未挿入かと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are no words in the bubble. Is it not that I've missed them because I can't read Japanese, but that the text hasn't been added yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the empty bubble is uninserted text rather than a reading oversight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示では、文字を入れる前の制作段階を紹介しています。空欄もその段階の状態です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This exhibit shows the production stage before text is added. The blank is part of that stage.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 作品の人物が無言だという場面ではないのですね。空欄から、何を言ったか勝手に決めずに見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無言場面とは限らず空欄だけで発言内容を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't necessarily a scene where the character is silent. I won't decide what they said from the blank alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming silence or dialogue content from the blank alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隣の解説には、作者がどんな会話を考えていたかを示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The neighboring description shows what conversation the author was considering.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 解説は読めます。自分で好きなせりふを作っても、それを作者の本当のせりふとして説明しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解説を読み自作せりふを作者の実際のせりふ扱いしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read the description. Even if I invent dialogue I like, I won't explain it as the author's actual words.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the description and avoid presenting invented dialogue as the author's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鑑賞後の体験コーナーなら、ご自分のせりふを考える活動もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: In the activity corner afterward you can create your own dialogue too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 体験コーナーに興味があります。展示原稿へ直接書くのではなく、配布された別の紙で考えるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別紙のせりふ体験を希望し展示原稿へ書かないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: That interests me. We use separate handouts rather than write directly on the exhibited manuscript, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request separate-paper dialogue activity and confirm no writing on the exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。紙は体験担当から受け取ってください。書いた物は作品の複製とは分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, receive paper from the activity staff. Your writing is handled separately from reproductions of the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の想像したせりふだと紙に記して持ち帰ります。展示の空欄と、私が考えた言葉を家族にも分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自作想像と記して持帰り展示空欄と自分の言葉を家族へ分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll mark the paper as my imagined dialogue and take it home. I'll distinguish the exhibit's blanks from my own words when telling my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Label your imagined dialogue and distinguish exhibit blanks and your words for family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、体験担当へお声をかけください。それでは、漫画の制作と想像の両方をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then speak to the activity staff. Enjoy both manga production and imagination.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 湯船のことでご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the bath?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 熱いお湯が苦手です。水を足して冷やしてから入ればよいと思ったのですが、みんなが使う湯船で自分が操作してよいのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同湯船へ水を足して冷やす操作を利用者がしてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hot water is difficult for me. I thought of adding cold water before entering; may a user adjust a shared bath like that?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a user may add water to cool a communal bath. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 湯船の給水などは、お客様が操作しないでください。利用する場所を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Guests shouldn't operate bath water supplies. Let's check where you can use instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分だけの好みに合わせて湯船を変えるのはやめます。今回は体を洗うだけの利用も考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 湯船を自己好みに変えず洗うだけの利用も考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't change the shared bath to my preference. I'm also considering just washing myself this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid changing the bath to your preference and consider washing only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 洗い場の設備についてご案内できます。湯船へ入ることは強制していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can explain washing-area facilities. Entering the bath isn't compulsory.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら今日は洗い場だけにします。湯船に入らないから受付を通さず利用できるという意味ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗い場のみを選び通常受付を省ける意味ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll use only the washing area today. That doesn't mean I can skip reception because I won't enter the bath, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose washing only and confirm normal reception still applies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通常の受付が必要です。洗い場を使う場合も、まわりの方に配慮をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Normal reception is required. Be considerate of others in the washing area too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付を済ませます。湯船の温度が変わるまで水を出し続けて待つこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付し湯船冷却目的で水を出し続けないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll register. I won't leave water running while waiting for the bath temperature to change either.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Complete reception and avoid running water to cool the bath. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設備の操作で分からない所は、実際に使う前に係へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask staff before using any equipment whose operation is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗い場の説明を聞いてから使います。熱さを我慢して入ったと報告するために無理をせず、今日は決めた範囲で利用します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に洗い場を使い熱さを我慢せず希望範囲で利用すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hear the washing-area explanation first. I won't force myself into heat just to say I did; I'll use only the scope I've chosen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the washing area after explanation without enduring excessive heat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を伺いました。それでは、無理のない範囲でご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've heard your preference. Please use the facilities within a comfortable range.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前通っていた学校の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have records from your previous school?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 時間割はありますが、成績の書類はまだ届いていません。時間割から勉強した科目を書けば、成績の代わりになると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外時間割はあるが成績資料未着で代用できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the timetable, but grade documents haven't arrived. I thought listing studied subjects from the timetable could replace grades.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the available overseas timetable and missing grades and possible substitution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 科目と成績は別に確認します。時間割で分かることは、そのまま担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check subjects and grades separately. Tell the responsible staff exactly what the timetable shows.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この科目を受けていたことは分かりますが、評価や点数は書かれていません。私が覚えている印象で点数を作ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 科目履修は分かるが点数未記載なので印象で評価を作らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It shows I attended these subjects, but gives no evaluations or scores. I won't invent marks from my memory's impression.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain subjects are shown but scores aren't and avoid inventing evaluations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 成績資料が未着であることも記録します。以前の学校へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll record that grades haven't arrived too. Can you contact your former school?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡できます。何という書類をお願いするか、必要な内容を担当へ聞いてから依頼したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧学校へ連絡可能で必要書類名と項目を聞いてから依頼したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to ask the staff the document name and required contents before requesting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you can contact the old school and want required document names and items first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類名や必要項目は担当が確認します。今お持ちの資料は原本ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check those. Is the material you have now the original?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これはコピーで、原本は家にあります。コピーを原本と説明せず、今日確認用として見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参はコピーで原本は自宅と分け確認用提示を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is a copy; the original is at home. I won't call the copy an original, but would like it viewed for checking today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the brought copy from the original at home and request checking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認用としてお預かりするかも、担当へ相談しましょう。翻訳済みの資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's ask the staff whether to accept it for checking too. Do you have translated records?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだありません。日本語で科目名を推測して書き替えず、原本の科目名を残して必要な翻訳方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 翻訳未実施で科目を推測改変せず原名を残して翻訳方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I won't guess and replace subject names in Japanese; I'll preserve original names and ask what translation method is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain translation is not done, preserve original subject names and ask translation requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へ未着資料とコピーの状況を引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらで案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the staff about missing records and the copy. Please wait here for guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご覧になりたい作品はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you chosen a film you'd like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この作品に興味がありますが、大きな音が苦手です。私の席だけ音を小さくしてもらえるのか、買う前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入前に大音量不安を伝え自席だけの音量変更可否を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested in this one, but loud sounds trouble me. Before buying, I'd like to know whether volume can be reduced only at my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before purchase, explain loud-sound concerns and ask about seat-specific volume. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通常の上映では、席ごとに音量を変える対応はしていません。作品の紹介をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Normal screenings don't adjust volume by seat. Would you like the film introduction?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 席だけ小さくなると思って買うのはやめます。紹介で分かる範囲を見てから、今日は見るか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別音量変更を前提に買わず紹介で分かる範囲を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't buy assuming my seat can be quieter. I'd like to check what the introduction tells me and then decide whether to watch today.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid buying based on individual volume changes and check the introduction first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紹介には大きな効果音を使う場面の説明がありますが、すべての音の大きさまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It describes scenes with loud sound effects, but doesn't show the loudness of every sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紹介にない場面は静かだと決めつけません。どの場面も平気だと保証してもらうつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紹介外は静かと断定せず全場面平気の保証は求めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume unlisted scenes are quiet. I'm not asking you to guarantee I'll be fine in every scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming unlisted scenes are quiet and don't seek a guarantee for all scenes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの作品や、別の日の鑑賞もご検討いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can consider other films or another day too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はこの作品の券を買わず、家で内容を調べ直します。興味がないからではなく、音の不安を整理したいからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音不安整理のため本日は未購入で自宅調査へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't buy this ticket today; I'll research again at home. Not because I'm uninterested, but to sort out my sound concerns.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Defer purchase and research at home to clarify sound concerns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内の紙を一部お渡しできます。お持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can give you a paper guide. Would you like one?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一部いただきます。同行する友人には、購入済みだと言わず、まだ買っていない理由も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内紙を希望し同行者へ未購入とその理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: One, please. I'll tell my accompanying friend I haven't bought it, rather than saying I have, and explain why.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a guide and tell your companion the ticket remains unbought and why. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内をどうぞ。それでは、また作品をお選びになった時にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the guide. We look forward to seeing you when you've selected a film.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 購入の記録について、分からない点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything unclear about recording purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事用に買った品と、家族の日用品が同じレシートにあります。合計全部を仕事の出費として写す前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事品と家庭日用品の混在レシート合計を全仕事出費へ転記前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Work items and my family's daily goods are on one receipt. I'd like advice before copying the whole total as work expenses.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult before entering a mixed work-and-household receipt total entirely as work expense. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品目ごとの内容と、何に使ったかを確認しましょう。レシート自体はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check each item and its use. Do you have the receipt itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原本はこちらです。上の二品は仕事に使いましたが、下の洗剤は家で家族が使うために買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本を示し上二品は仕事用で洗剤は家族家庭用と用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the original. The first two items were used for work, but the detergent below was bought for family use at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the original and distinguish two work items from household detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その説明を担当へ伝えます。仕事に使ったという理由だけで、こちらで扱いを確定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the adviser. We can't finalize treatment here just because you used something for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使い道を説明したら必ず認められるとは思わず、担当の確認を受けます。まず家庭用の品を合計へ一緒に足さないよう、別のメモにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用途説明だけで扱い確定と思わず家庭用品を別メモへ分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume explaining use guarantees acceptance; I'll have the adviser check. First I'll note household items separately so I don't add them into the same total.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming classification is settled by use alone and separately note household goods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原本を切って品目を分けたりせず、全体が確認できるようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't cut the original to separate items; keep it so everything can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本は切らずに残します。別紙に品目と使い道を書いて、どの行のことか番号で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本を切らず別紙に品目用途と行番号を書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave it uncut. On a separate sheet I'll write items and uses and number the relevant receipt lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the original uncut and list item uses and line numbers separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返金された品や、まだ支払っていない物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Any refunded items or things not yet paid for?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二品とも支払い済みで返金はありません。家庭用洗剤も同じ会計ですが、私の説明では仕事用品と分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 仕事二品は支払済み未返金と答え家庭洗剤は別用途として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both work items are paid and not refunded. Household detergent was in the same payment, but I'll explain its different use separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm two work items paid and unrefunded and distinguish household detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、原本と別紙を担当へお見せください。それでは、ご相談の準備をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-NAGAHAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then show the original and separate sheet to the adviser. Please prepare for consultation.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族の皆さんはそろいましたか。

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人が体調を理由に今日は乗らないと言っています。私は受付で四人と伝えましたが、乗るのは三人になります。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人見送りで実乗船人数が変わると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-02.translation: One person says they won't board today because they're unwell. I told reception four, but only three will board.
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain one cancellation changes actual boarding numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見送る方は、この乗り場で待たれますか。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will the person not boarding wait at this landing?

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、宿へ先に戻ります。帰りにこの場所へ残っていると思って探さないよう、家族にも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見送り家族は宿へ戻ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they'll return to the accommodation first. I want to tell the family so we don't look for them here afterward.
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the nonboarding family member is returning to the accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数の変更を受付に伝え、船側の名簿も確認します。船が出てから変更を知らせるのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll tell reception the number change and check the onboard list too. Avoid waiting until departure to inform us.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発前に伝えます。見送る一人は誰かを、この名簿の名前で示します。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発前に不参加者を名簿で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell you before departure. I'll identify the nonparticipant by name on this list.
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the nonparticipant on the list before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が船へ向かっていないことも確認できますか。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you confirm they aren't heading toward the boat?

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宿へ戻ると本人から連絡が来ています。残る三人はここにいて、私がまとめて返事をします。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の連絡と残る三人の在所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-08.translation: They've contacted me saying they're returning to the accommodation. The remaining three are here, and I'll answer for us.
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm direct contact and the remaining three's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗らない方の券の扱いは、受付で別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask reception separately about the unused ticket.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 人数を伝え直してから受付へ聞きます。券を持っていることと、実際に乗ることは分けて伝えました。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数変更後に未使用券の扱いを受付へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask after correcting the number. I've distinguished having tickets from actually boarding.
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask reception about the unused ticket after changing the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三人と確認しました。それでは、皆さんで船へお進みください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-001-SHARED-11.translation: Three confirmed. Please all proceed to the boat. Enjoy your trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらの部屋へ入る際は、段差にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Mind the step when entering this room.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 薄暗くて、敷居がどこまで高いか見えません。かばんを持ったまま踏み越えるのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 薄暗い敷居で荷物があり跨ぐのが不安と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: It's dim, so I can't see how high the threshold is. I'm uneasy stepping over while holding my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Express concern crossing a dim threshold with luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: いったん手前で止まってください。敷居の位置をこちらからお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Stop before it for now. I'll show the threshold position.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ここで止まります。展示の柱へつかまろうとしていましたが、触る前に相談してよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 手前で止まり展示柱へ未接触と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll stop here. I was going to hold the exhibit pillar, but I'm glad I asked before touching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Stop before it and explain no contact with the exhibit pillar yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 柱にはつかまらないでください。お荷物を体の前から横へ移すと、足元が見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Don't hold the pillar. If you move the bag from in front to your side, can you see your footing?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 横へ持ち替えたら見えました。敷居の上に足を置くより、向こう側へ一歩でまたぐのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 荷物を移して段差が見え跨ぎ方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: I can see after changing hands. Should I step over to the other side in one step rather than put my foot on the threshold?
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Move luggage, see the step and ask how to cross. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 歩きやすい方法は無理のない範囲で選んでください。入らず入口からご覧になることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Choose a comfortable method without forcing it. You may also view from the doorway without entering.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は入口から見ます。入室しないと説明を聞けないのかと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 無理に入室せず入口見学を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll view from the doorway today. I thought I had to enter to hear the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose doorway viewing without forcing entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 入口からでも、台所についての説明はお伝えできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: We can explain the kitchen from the doorway too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そこからお願いします。かばんは通路へ置かず手元で持ち、後ろから来る方が通れるよう横へ寄ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 荷物を持ち通行を空け入口で説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please do it from there. I'll keep the bag with me, not in the passage, and stand aside for people behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Hold luggage, clear passage and request doorway explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、こちらから台所をご案内します。続きの見学もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-02-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll introduce the kitchen from here. Enjoy the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お菓子へお名前を入れるご注文ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: An order for names on sweets, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。渡す相手の名字をひらがなで控えてきましたが、漢字はまだ分かりません。見本にある字で作ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 相手の漢字未確認で見本名使用を迷うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. I noted the recipient's surname in hiragana, but don't know the kanji yet. I'm unsure whether to use the characters in the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain unconfirmed surname characters and uncertainty about using the sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 見本の名字をご本人の表記として使うことはできません。どなたかに確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: We can't use a sample surname as their spelling. Can you check with someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 同じ職場の人へ聞けます。でも、驚かせたいので相手本人へ聞くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 本人へ直接聞かず同僚確認を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: I can ask a coworker. But I want a surprise, so would prefer not to ask the recipient directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Consider coworker verification rather than directly asking the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 確認できないまま作るより、名入れなしの品を選ぶ方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Rather than make them unconfirmed, you can choose unpersonalized items.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それなら名前のない菓子に変えたいです。渡す日だけは決まっているので、名前を調べ続けて受取りを遅らせたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 期日に間に合わせ名入れなしへ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'd like to switch to sweets without a name. The giving date is fixed, and I don't want collection delayed while I keep searching for spelling.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Switch to no personalization to meet the fixed date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 名入れの製作はまだ始めていません。通常の品へ変更する数を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Personalization hasn't started. How many should we switch to standard items?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 六個です。すべて名前なしにして、個別の袋にも他人の名字を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 通常品六個と袋も無名を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Six. All without names, and don't put someone else's surname on the individual bags either.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Specify six standard items and unnamed bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 箱の表のご用途の札はどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: What about the occasion label on the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お礼とだけ書いていただけますか。相手の名前はカードにも推測で書かず、確認できたら自分で添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 箱札をお礼だけにし氏名カードは確認後にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Could it say just thank you? I won't guess the recipient's name on a card either; I'll add it myself once confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request only a thank-you box label and defer the name card until verified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 六個の通常品とお礼の札で承りました。それでは、受取りの日にお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-03-001-SHARED.translation: Six standard items and a thank-you label accepted. We look forward to collection day.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その器具をお使いになりたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: Would you like to use that machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。前の方が椅子から離れたので、重りを軽くして使おうと思いましたが、まだ荷物がそばにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 前利用者が離れた器具を使いたいが荷物があると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. The previous user left the seat, so I thought of lightening the weight and using it, but their things are still nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Discuss using vacated equipment with the previous user's belongings still present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その方は一組の運動の途中で休んでいます。空いているとはまだ言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: They're resting between sets. We can't say it's free yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 休憩と利用終了は違うのですね。重りのピンはまだ触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 休憩中と理解しピン未操作を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: So resting and finishing are different. I haven't touched the weight pin yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Understand it is a rest and report no pin operation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 触らずにお待ちください。初めて使う器具でしたら、使用前の説明も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: Wait without touching. If it's your first time, you also need an explanation before using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 初めてです。前の人の重さを見て自分にも合うと判断せず、職員の説明を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 他人の重さを採用せず初回説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: It is my first time. I won't assume another person's weight suits me; I'd like staff instruction.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Avoid adopting another user's weight and request first-time instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 説明できる職員を呼びます。器具のすぐ後ろではなく、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll call an instructor. Wait here, not immediately behind the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらへ移ります。休んでいる方に早く終えるよう言うこともせず、ほかの運動を先にできるか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 近くで急かさず待機場所へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll move here. I won't urge the resting person to finish; I'll consider whether I could do another exercise first.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Move to waiting without hovering or rushing the other user. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 説明の順番が来たらお呼びします。今、別の器具を使い始める予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: We'll call when it's your turn for instruction. Are you starting another machine now?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 別の器具もまだ分からないので、先に説明を待ちます。戻った方が使う前に重さを変えてしまわなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 他器具も未習得なので説明を優先すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: I don't know other machines either, so I'll wait for instruction first. I'm glad I didn't change the weight before they returned to use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Prioritize instruction because other machines are unfamiliar too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 未操作と確認しました。では、担当の説明をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-04-001-SHARED.translation: No operation confirmed. Please wait for the instructor. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 瓶詰め前の準備は進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: How is preparation before bottling going?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 空のケースへ上着を置いてしまいました。後で洗浄済み容器を載せる台だと気づいたので、作業前に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 洗浄済容器用台へ上着を置いたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: I put my jacket on an empty case. I realized it is a stand for washed containers later, so I'm telling you before work.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Report putting a jacket on a stand for washed containers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: どのケースですか。もう上着は取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: Which case? Have you removed the jacket?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 青いケースです。上着は取りましたが、きれいに見えるからそのまま使ってよいとは判断していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 対象ケースと自己安全判断していない点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: The blue case. I've removed it, but haven't assumed it is usable just because it looks clean.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Identify the case and avoid your own safety judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのケースは使用を待ち、衛生管理の担当へ確認します。瓶はまだ載せていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: We'll hold use and check with hygiene staff. Have any bottles been placed on it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: まだです。上着を置いた後に瓶を載せたケースはありません。隣のケースは別で、私物を置いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 接触後の瓶なしと隣ケース非接触を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: Not yet. No case had bottles placed after my jacket. The neighboring case is separate and had no personal belongings on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain no bottles after contact and no contact with the neighboring case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 対象を分けておきましょう。ご自身で消毒液をかける必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: Let's distinguish the affected case. You don't need to apply disinfectant yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 青いケースに使用待ちと示します。手持ちの除菌スプレーで処置するのもやめ、担当の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 使用待ち表示と自己消毒をしない方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll mark blue as awaiting use. I won't treat it with my own sanitizing spray; I'll wait for instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Mark the hold and avoid self-disinfection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 瓶詰めを始める担当へも、待っている理由を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: Tell the bottling operator why we're waiting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 私物が触れた台の扱いを確認中だと伝えます。工程が遅れるのが心配でも、黙って瓶を置いて始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 開始担当へ待機理由を伝え工程優先で隠さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll explain we're checking handling of a stand touched by personal belongings. Even if delay worries me, I won't silently put bottles down and start.
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Tell the operator the hold reason without hiding it to prioritize production. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 知らせてくれて助かりました。衛生担当へ確認しますので、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SHG-OMIHACHIMAN-05-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for reporting. I'll check with hygiene staff. Excuse me for now.
